_source: Recorded from the Square sandbox on 2026-10-27 by the coordinator (POST /v2/inventory/counts/batch-retrieve, Square-Version 2025-10-16), against a throwaway item with five tracked variations, deleted afterward. Ids scrubbed to the placeholders below and the location to <LOCATION_ID>; nothing else changed.
_record: In the sandbox, five variations with inventory tracked at one location, counts set to 0, 3, 2, 5 and 4. Give the first some stock, then a physical count of 0, so Square answers it with a row at quantity "0": the tests need that row, and read a variation Square leaves out as not counted, which fails them. POST /v2/inventory/counts/batch-retrieve with the request below, all five ids in that order. The code asks for the first three alone; the other two are recorded so the tests can show a hiatus and a discontinued tier with stock are ignored, so keep all five. Scrub the variation ids to VAR-OUT-ZERO, VAR-OUT-SOME, VAR-ARCH-SOME, VAR-HIATUS-SOME and VAR-DISC-SOME, and the location to <LOCATION_ID>.
_shows: Square's IN_STOCK counts at the farm's location for an inStock false variation at 0, one at 3, an archived one at 2, a hiatus one at 5 and a discontinued one at 4.
